responsibility: This file implements a targeted frontend consistency check for source locations. In the gm2 tree-building and diagnostic pipeline it validates that a location_t survives the M2Options location override machinery unchanged, except for GCC’s special builtins and unknown locations, and reports an internal compiler error if location metadata appears corrupted.
same_name_distinction: This file contains the only runtime implementation in the m2assert pair: the location validator that checks M2Options_OverrideLocation preserves ordinary source locations and raises internal_error on corruption. The header instead mainly supplies reusable assertion macros and the declaration.
